# Repository Map

*This document is automatically generated from the repository structure.*

Repository structure documentation will be automatically generated when you:
1. Push changes to the repository
2. The `update-docs` workflow runs
3. Changes are merged

The map includes:
- Directory tree
- File descriptions (from docstrings and comments)
- File categorization
- Important files highlighting

See the [update-docs workflow](../../.github/workflows/update-docs.yml) for details.
